title: Manoeuvre question
description: A choice question whose options are pushes, one under the other, each with a small diagram of the push. A fork of the quiz block: same scoring, feedback, saved state and SCORM records.
instructions: Use for questions whose options are manoeuvres. Give each option a diagram (images/burn-<direction>.svg, generated by generators/figures.mjs). The diagram shows what the option says (the direction of the push), never the outcome. Two to four options, short feedback (feedbackStyle compact): the explanation comes after the question.

figure.description: Diagram of the burn (decorative: the option text says it).

props.stem: You fly **50 km behind** the client satellite. Which first burn closes the gap?
